name: Pulpí (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of dark red, white and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pulpí (a black double-headed eagle bearing a shield).
history: Municipal flag of Pulpí; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Pulpí arms — black double-headed eagle with a shield
